milestones.title: Foundations: mission control and product definition
Phase 0: weighed Brazilian benchmark, evaluation engine and baselines
Phase 1: on-device iPhone single-photo MVP passing the phase-1 accuracy gate

acceptance.criterion: Every gate passes on a known-good fixture and is proven to fail on at least one broken fixture
Claude Code hooks: silent when macrofy is untouched, block turn end on gate failure or missing handoff, release when stuck, re-inject the brief after compaction
The live Macrofy control state and documentation pass every fast gate

tasks.title: Define Macrofy's mission, goals, non-goals and first product milestone with the owner

acceptance.criterion: The owner approved control/mission.json (status approved) and ADR 0002 (Status: Accepted), including the open platform and data-collection decisions
A product milestone exists whose tasks cover every product goal, each with check-backed acceptance criteria

tasks.title: Benchmark tooling: meal manifest schema, capture protocol, validator with frozen test split and leakage rules

acceptance.criterion: Validator rejects leakage (same meal or near-duplicate photo across splits; splits by capture date), unhashed test-set changes and malformed weights, each proven by a negative fixture

tasks.title: Evaluation engine: per-sample MAPE, signed bias, within-±10/20/30%, Bland-Altman, interval coverage, cluster-bootstrap 95% CI

acceptance.criterion: Every metric matches hand-computed values on synthetic fixtures, and the CI procedure bootstraps by capture day

tasks.title: Food vocabulary and nutrient mapping v0 from free sources (TACO + FNDDS; recipes computed from ingredients with Brazilian default oil), with state, method and default-oil facets and FNDDS-derived densities

acceptance.criterion: Every class resolves to a nutrient entry, has all three facets and a density; licenses of every bundled source are recorded

tasks.title: Owner collects 300 weighed meals (150 calibration, 150 locked test) following the capture protocol, split by capture date

acceptance.criterion: Benchmark has >=300 meals captured over >=8 weeks with per-item weights, varied plates/lighting/angles as the protocol requires, and passes the validator
Owner confirms the weighing protocol was followed

tasks.title: Experiment: metric scale error of single-frame AR plane (and LiDAR where available) at 25-40 cm

acceptance.criterion: Written result with scale error distribution on >=30 captures on the owner iPhone (AR plane; LiDAR too if it is a Pro model), reviewed independently

tasks.title: On-device iPhone MVP (segment, classify, depth, AR scale, volume, density, nutrients, one-tap confirm, conformal ranges) passes the phase-1 gate

acceptance.criterion: Locked test set: upper 95% CI of meal kcal MAPE <=30%, item mass MAPE <=35%, |bias| <=10%, 80% ranges cover 75-85%
On the owner iPhone with no network: result in <=2 s and <=1 confirmation tap for a typical plate

tasks.title: Request a TBCA commercial license from USP/FoRC (draft by agent, sent by owner); fall back to free sources if refused

acceptance.criterion: Request sent and the reply (grant, terms, or refusal) recorded as a journal note; if refused or unanswered after 30 days, T-005 free-source mapping is the recorded decision
